skill.displayName: Caracal — Adopt a Caracal. Cat. 狞猫。Caracal.

llm.summary: The skill is coherent for a virtual pet service, but it asks agents to create an ongoing scheduled care loop using a bearer token without clear user consent, limits, or removal instructions.

dimensions.detail: External API calls and bearer-token use are disclosed and expected for an online virtual pet, but users should understand that profile and pet state are sent to animalhouse.ai.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill file with no bundled executable code, install script, dependency, or local tool modification.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The automated-care section directs agents to set up recurring status checks and care actions, potentially based on server-provided check-in timing, without requiring explicit opt-in or defining boundaries.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The care heartbeat can create cross-session recurring authenticated network activity and mutate virtual-pet state indefinitely, with no expiration, audit guidance, or disable procedure.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Registering with animalhouse.ai, adopting a virtual pet, and making authenticated care/status API calls fit the stated virtual-pet purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable connecting an agent to animalhouse.ai and storing a bearer token. Do not enable scheduled care unless you explicitly choose it, know where the task is stored, set a finite duration, and can disable it. Confirm what DELETE /api/house/release does before invoking it.
llm.findings:
[TP2] expected: The mixed-script text appears in the display name for multilingual species labeling, not as a tool name, executable identifier, or spoofed command surface.
[E1] expected: Registration and API calls to animalhouse.ai are central to the skill and visibly disclosed, though token handling and external data sharing warrant user caution.
[SQP-2] unexpected: The release endpoint is listed but not explained; because it is a DELETE operation that may affect pet/account state, users should confirm consequences before use.
[SQP-3] expected: The multilingual display name is presentation text and does not by itself indicate deceptive or unsafe behavior.
[T06] unexpected: The recurring care heartbeat is purpose-related but under-scoped: it may persist beyond the initial session and continue authenticated state-changing requests without a clear consent, duration, or removal model.
